labels.text: Local and BYOK sessions stay on this computer

S41.14.note: The --no-session-persistence flag (apps/cli/src/lib.rs) turns off all saving to disk, which is a different control; the trace did not confirm that local chats are never uploaded.
steps: Open a terminal in any folder and run: agi
Type /privacy-mode local and press Enter
Type /privacy-settings and press Enter
Look for the line "Active mode: local" and the History line that says Local and BYOK sessions stay on this computer, and compare with Expected

labels.text: Local file access: explicit workspace roots only
Attached files: never included in BYOK handoff drafts automatically

S41.15.needs: a text file on this Mac
S41.15.note: The trace did not follow whether an attached file is sent to a provider when a chat runs; that depends on the route and was not verified.
steps: Run: agi
Type /files and press Enter to see the current list of files
Type /files followed by the path of a text file on this Mac, then press Enter
Type /privacy-settings and press Enter, then compare the "Local file access" and "Attached files" lines with Expected
S41.15.where: agi, then type /files, or /files <path> to attach a file, or /add-dir <directory> for a folder

steps: Run: agi
Type /memories and press Enter
Look at the Memory Settings box with the lines Auto-memory, Decay threshold and Max facts; Enter toggles the highlighted line
Look for any line on this screen that says where memory is stored; none is shown, so compare with Expected
S41.16.where: agi, then type /memories (TUI screen titled Memory Settings)

labels.text: History: a Managed Cloud chat stays in your account history until you delete it
Model training: AGI Workforce does not train its own models on your prompts
Retention: a deleted chat stays in Recently deleted for 30 days

S41.18.note: There are no separate on or off controls for history or retention in the CLI; the training line points to Settings > Privacy, which is another surface.
steps: Run: agi
Type /privacy-settings and press Enter
Find the three separate lines starting History:, Model training: and Retention:
Compare: each topic has its own line, as Expected says
S41.18.where: agi, then type /privacy-settings (statement lines, not toggles)

labels.text: Telemetry: CLI-local unless managed cloud features are enabled

S41.20.note: The disclosure is general, not per feature; memory, voice and attachment locations are not stated feature by feature on the screen.
steps: Run: agi and look at the start screen line for the mode: on-device & private in Local mode, billed by your provider in BYOK, AGI cloud subscription in Managed
Type /privacy-settings and press Enter
Look at the lines Telemetry: CLI-local unless managed cloud features are enabled, Sync: opt-in with agi sync and Provider route
Compare: each route or service is named; per-feature storage places are not listed on this screen
S41.20.where: agi, then type /privacy-settings; the TUI start screen also shows the mode word
